title: Causal Effect of Obstructive Sleep Apnea on Sick Sinus Syndrome: A Bidirectional Mendelian Randomization Study.
authors: Chen W, Pan W, Ling L, Jiang B, Zhang Y, Su X, Jiang T, Lin J.
figures: Study design. The purpose of this bidirectional two-sample MR analysis is to investigate the causal relationship between OSA and SSS. The GWAS meta-analysis for this study is from mixed-sex European cohorts.
Associations of genetically predicted OSA with risk of SSS. P-value and 95CI% specific value are listed on the right side.

Scatter plots of causal associations and leave-one-out sensitivity analysis for OSA on SSS. ( A ) Individual estimates about the causal effect of OSA on SSS. ( B ) leave-one-out analysis for OSA on SSS.
